rec_texts: In lieu of all Bills other than original Bills
Order to Amend, how applied for.
As to waiting for all the Answers before amending.
Application always to the Court and not to the Master
May be confined to short Statement.
Omission to deny Statement is no Admission
On case made by Answer, Decree may be so framed as
Application for Time to the Master, and Orders dawn
